versions.policy: Pin actual installed file hashes from library-evidence, not only package version

finite.line: Required positive finite integer within exact original source line count
finite.column: Required finite nonnegative integer measured in UTF-16 code units and within declared original line boundary
finite.presence: All four start/end properties present; raw null is never a finite coordinate

mapped-end-sentinel.allowedOnly: Positive Infinity in end.column, with finite end.line; never start.column or any line
mapped-end-sentinel.proof: Exact retained runtime conversion provenance must prove Locator.getLoc executed its u.length===0 sentinel path for this emitted location. Source/map/runtime/converter/AST policy replay or direct trace must bind the marker. Shape alone is not enough.
mapped-end-sentinel.libraryOrigin: converter getLoc line292; applies to any mapped location type, not only branches

implicit-else-arm.allowedOnly: A complete location with all four own line/column properties undefined in one branchMap[id].locations[index], generated by onBranch missing alternate for type if
implicit-else-arm.proof: Original and emitted AST identify the corresponding if with no alternate; keep branch/counter and source parent location. Require full synthetic arm, never arbitrary partial undefined properties.
implicit-else-arm.libraryOrigin: converter onBranch lines530-540 from getWalker IfStatement optional alternate

wireEncoding.profile: Keep finite original map values and exact map IDs/names/types/order. Preserve every original zero and every counter; no new coverage hits are synthesized.
wireEncoding.sidecar: Before JSON serialization, emit a hash-bound typed coordinateKinds marker for each permitted Infinity/undefined location, including reason/provenance and parent map identity. The sidecar is mandatory for any non-finite/synthetic marker.
wireEncoding.legacyJSON: Legacy null end columns and absent branch coordinates are untyped. They are historical diagnostics only and cannot be decoded into accepted raw sentinels or merged solely because JSON bytes match.
wireEncoding.wireNull: Permitted only where a matching validated positive-Infinity marker exists. Null without a marker fails; null anywhere else fails.
wireEncoding.wireMissing: Permitted only for all four fields of an exact marked synthetic implicit-else location. Partial missing fields fail.
wireEncoding.forbidden: Never JSON-roundtrip arbitrary raw input to make comparisons pass. Never convert NaN, negative Infinity, undefined required positions, invalid booleans/fractional/negative values or malformed map topology into accepted data.

comparison.scope: Compare complete decoded typed statementMap/fnMap/branchMap AND all original identity/provenance. Coordinate-kind equivalence is separate from genuine AST/map differences.
requirements: Both producers declare the same reviewed original-node/coordinate contract
Complete compatible maps, including keys, function names/declarations/locations, branch types/arms and counts, must agree
Duplicate producer/snapshot identities and overlapping reset windows fail
Counter vectors retain matching dimensions and nonnegative finite integer hits
notAllowed: Matching only known passing functions or branches
Map-ID renumbering to conceal differing nodes
Copying hits across differently mapped subjects
Dropping unsupported original source or thresholds

requiredTestsNotYetRun: Finite UTF-16 coordinates including astral Unicode and CRLF map exactly; no off-by-one clipping.
Positive Infinity at attested end.column is tagged/restored; Infinity at start or line rejects.
NaN, -Infinity, null raw coordinate, boolean, negative/fractional/out-of-bounds positions reject.
Implicit missing else preserves its original branch counter and zero-hit arm; incomplete or unmarked undefined fields reject.
Wire null/missing without matching sidecar marker or mismatched sidecar/source/runtime/hash rejects.
Legacy serialized maps cannot claim the new policy automatically.
Exact all-three-map comparison still rejects missing authored functions, added compiler nodes, changed branch arms and differing function names.
Duplicate snapshot IDs/overlapping snapshots reject; counter dimensions/zeros stay unchanged.
Actual Vitest and Node runtime controls with untouched functions and branches establish compatible complete maps before any merge.
